recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If future review finds a particular composite search parameter with an incorrect component expression or unresolved component definition, file or reconcile that resource-specific issue separately; do not reopen FHIR-11088 absent a broader work-group decision.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Observation request to make composite search parameters such as Observation code-value-[x] computable by splitting ambiguous Observation composites and defining SearchParameter.component.expression as the extraction expression that overrides the referenced component parameter expression.
initial_application: Jira records Grahame Grieve applying the issue in svn revision 10444. The 2016 #implementers R3 Draft Zulip thread for GF#11088 shows the agreed model: a composite SearchParameter has a main expression selecting indexable items and component sub-expressions such as code and value.as(Quantity). No explicit FHIR-11088 commit exists in the current git history; -S history shows the current source preserved through later 2021 source rework commits c69d71a and 33b409a.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Observation and SearchParameter as active resources. SearchParameter.component.expression is mandatory and explicitly overrides the referenced definition expression. Observation now has split code-value-concept/date/quantity/string composites, component-code-value-concept/quantity composites, and combo composites whose main expression and relative component expressions prevent top-level/component Cartesian pairing. Later FHIR-25297 and its Zulip discussion use the same semantics for a Group-specific correction and do not supersede FHIR-11088.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source hunk was needed because the current source already conveys the requested behavior and the remaining relevant composite defects should be handled as resource-specific tickets rather than changes to the FHIR-11088 model.

related_jiras.note: Later Published Group composite correction that relies on component.expression overriding the referenced parameter expression, confirming the FHIR-11088 model remains current.
